name: std::forward_as_tuple
intro: Constructs a tuple of references to the arguments in args suitable for forwarding as an argument to a function. The tuple has rvalue reference data members when rvalues are used as arguments, and otherwise has lvalue reference data members.

sections.title: Parameters
sections.text:
args

 -

 zero or more arguments to construct the tuple from

sections.title: Return value
sections.text: A std::tuple object created as if by std::tuple<Types&&...>(std::forward<Types>(args)...)

sections.title: Notes
sections.text: If the arguments are temporaries, forward_as_tuple does not extend their lifetime; they have to be used before the end of the full expression.

summary: Constructs a tuple of references to the arguments in args suitable for forwarding as an argument to a function. The tuple has rvalue reference data members when rvalues are used as arguments, and otherwise has lvalue reference data members.
